clusters.name: deterministic-assertions
clusters.executionModeRationale: US-001 only strengthens existing inline #[cfg(test)] modules with no network and no new crate, so it is independent of the capstone and ships the gated no-network acceptance criteria first; it can even run in parallel with US-002 since it touches disjoint files.

clusters.name: capstone
clusters.executionModeRationale: US-002 (new overlay leaf crate + chat-SSE harness + COPILOT_API_HOME token-cache fixture, with the core_test_support reachability preflight) and US-003 (the multi-turn wiremock test_codex e2e that consumes them) share the new leaf crate and the process-global anthropic gate; US-003 cannot compile until US-002 lands, so they MUST serialize. dependsOn deterministic-assertions is an ordering preference (US-001 should land first to de-risk), not a hard code dependency.
